scope: Formal continuation q=k^2-omega^2 of fixed Euclidean coefficient inverses. Upper-pole locations and toy pole-sector inversions do not choose a microscopic contour, retarded quantum theory or physical completion.
interpretation: Causal inverse-Laplace response can grow exponentially. Real-axis inversion of off-real pole sectors decays both ways but is generally nonzero before the source. No full-kernel time evolution or nonlinear stability was computed.
